# RedFox Comprehensive Knowledge Base & Technical Specification
Developer: BitLabs Technology PLC
Product: RedFox Enterprise Cyber-Resilience Engine
Website: https://redfox.bitlabsbuild.com

---

## 1. Executive Summary & Value Proposition

RedFox is an enterprise-grade cyber-resilience platform engineered by BitLabs Technology PLC to systematically eliminate human risk in organizational cybersecurity. While traditional security awareness training relies on static annual videos, RedFox delivers adaptive, continuous, micro-learning and automated threat simulations directly into daily workflows.

RedFox enables CISOs and security leadership to:
- Reduce phishing susceptibility rates by up to 88% within 90 days.
- Automate compliance audits for ISO 27001, SOC 2, HIPAA, GDPR, and PCI-DSS.
- Benchmark organizational Human Risk Index (HRI) across departments and peer industries.
- Reduce SOC analyst triage overhead via automated 1-click threat reporting and AI triage.

---

## 2. Product Capabilities & Technical Architecture

### A. Adaptive Phishing & Spear-Phishing Engine
- Contextually tailored phishing simulations mimicking real-world APT (Advanced Persistent Threat) techniques.
- Multi-vector simulations including email phishing, spear-phishing, QR code phishing (quishing), and SMS phishing (smishing).
- Automated risk-based triggers: Employees who fail a simulation receive immediate, 60-second micro-reinforcement modules.

### B. Micro-Learning & Behavior Modification
- Interactive 2 to 3 minute modules delivered via web, email, Slack, or Microsoft Teams.
- High-engagement scenario-based training covering credential safety, social engineering, ransomware identification, data privacy, and remote worker security.
- Available in 25+ international languages with localized cultural nuance.

### C. Human Risk Index (HRI) Analytics
- Real-time quantitative risk scoring engine calculating HRI scores (0-100) based on simulation performance, training completion speed, and reporting speed.
- Executive reporting dashboard providing board-ready visualization of risk trends and ROI metrics.

### D. Incident Response Button & Automated Triage
- One-click plugin for Outlook, Gmail, and mobile email clients allowing users to report suspicious emails instantly.
- Automated headers & payload parsing with sandboxed AI triage that categorizes reported emails as Spam, Benign, or Malicious Threat.

## 4. Licensing & Commercial Packages

1. **Starter Tier**:
   - Up to 250 users.
   - Monthly automated phishing campaigns, core micro-learning library, standard compliance reporting, email support.
2. **Professional Tier**:
   - Up to 1,000 users.
   - Advanced spear-phishing & quishing, complete micro-learning library, 1-click threat reporting button, HRI analytics dashboard, SSO integration.
3. **Enterprise Tier**:
   - Unlimited scaling (1,000+ users).
   - Dedicated threat architect, custom scenario builder, SIEM/SOAR API integrations, white-glove onboarding, 24/7 priority SLA, custom compliance mapping.
